_inspectorSnowReport.Report: Tuesday, April 7, 5:45 a.m. On tap for today: sparkling sunshine and spring vibes. Indulge in some tropical spring weather with beautiful blue skies and temperatures in the upper 40s and low 50s today. Clouds will pick up around noon, then clear out later in the afternoon. Take a scenic lap on Dynamite to soak up the stunning views. Spring conditions exist and coverage is thin in many areas so keep a look out when cruising the trails today. Advanced skills are required when descending Powderhorn and Apex Express terrain. Beginners and intermediate skiers and riders will find the best conditions on Moonbeam Express terrain. The Soli Parks Tow is closed for the season, but the Main Street Terrain Park remains open for all your jibbing, sliding, and jumping needs. Have a terrific Tuesday!
